main.summary: Relays one process output stream to a live observer stream and optionally captures all bytes for a buffered result.
main.remarks: The relay owns the intermediate pipe and optional in-memory collector. It reads the process stream continuously, copies each chunk to the collector when enabled, forwards the chunk to the observer stream, and completes that stream when input ends or process startup fails.

field.name: capture
field.summary: Optional in-memory copy of all bytes read by the process-output pump.

field.name: output
field.summary: Intermediate pipe carrying output bytes to the observer-side stream.

field.name: writerCompleted
field.summary: Atomic flag preventing the intermediate pipe writer from being completed more than once.

field.name: outputStream
field.summary: Stream view over the observer-side pipe reader.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.param: True to retain all relayed bytes for a buffered result.
constructor.returns: A relay exposing the observer-side stream and capture result.

property.name: Stream
property.summary: Gets the live stream that an output observer can consume.
property.returns: Observer-side stream containing process output as it is relayed.

method.name: PumpAsync
method.summary: Reads a process output stream, captures each chunk when enabled, and forwards it to the observer-side stream.
method.param: Cancellation token for reading and forwarding.
method.returns: A task that completes when the source ends or an error occurs.

method.name: Complete
method.summary: Completes the observer-side stream if its process-output pump did not complete it.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Releases the observer-side pipe and optional capture buffer.

method.name: CopyCapturedBytes
method.summary: Returns a copy of all bytes captured by this relay.
method.returns: Captured bytes, or an empty array when capture is disabled.
